newsitem.title: UK: Britain tells nationals to leave northern Iraq.
newsitem.headline: Britain tells nationals to leave northern Iraq.

text.p: Britain on Tuesday told its citizens working for aid organisations in northern Iraq to leave.
"In view of the situation in northern Iraq, the Foreign Office is advising all UK nationals to leave," a spokesman said.
Around 30 British aid workers are believed to be working in northern Iraq, where Iraqi troops have moved into opposition-held territory to assist one Kurdish faction against another.
